Based on the images provided:

**Is the active thread in the left sidebar clearly highlighted?**
No. In fact, the left sidebar containing the thread list has been completely removed in Image 2. The "New consciousness thread" header now sits at the top of the main content area, and there is no sidebar to show an active thread highlight.

**Is the New thread button more prominent?**
The "New thread" button (the '+' icon) is no longer visible as a distinct element in Image 2. It appears the interface has shifted to a model where the main view is always a "New consciousness thread," removing the need for a separate creation button.

**Does image 2 look more polished overall?**
Yes, Image 2 looks significantly more polished. The removal of the cluttered error toast ("Wake word waiting...") and the elimination of the sidebar creates a much cleaner, more focused "zen" mode. The layout feels more spacious and modern.

**Any new visual problems in image 2?**
There are no glaring visual bugs, but the removal of the sidebar might be a functional regression if users rely on switching between multiple conversation threads. Additionally, the notification badge on the bell icon (showing "13") is quite large and slightly distracting compared to the rest of the minimalist UI. The "Deep Research" toggle also seems a bit orphaned without the sidebar context.
